info.title: Mappi API
info.description: The contract of both React apps and of external integrators (PRD §8).

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The store page the widget is on

200.description: Bare JSON: the respondent link of the matching flow

get.summary: Newest first; an Admin sees every account's. `questionnaire_id` finds the assignation of a questionnaire.

parameters.name: questionnaire_id
parameters.description: Only the assignations of this questionnaire (the form checks the one-organization rule with it)

201.description: The respondent link and the id

get.summary:
Public (the respondent page). An anonymous caller needs the owner's plan to include assignations (429) and does
not see the description nor the answers; a console user sees only their account's (another's is 404).

put.summary: Partial. `type` cannot change; `due_date: null` clears it; the organization stays while in a project.

delete.summary: 204. Counts one "assignations" (AssignationDeleted). The respondents' answers stay.

get.summary: A, a non-owner receives an empty page. The audience by name, with each member's status and attempts.

put.summary: Approve or reject one answer of the current attempt of a complete follow-up.

post.summary: "Send for correction": 201 with the new attempt. With 502 RETRY_EMAIL_NOT_SENT the attempt already exists.

get.summary: Newest first; an Admin sees every account's.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Every word in the project's or its organization's name

get.summary: The enriched project, with the follow-ups that may join it (available_assignations).

put.summary: Partial. assignation_ids replaces the set; organization_id may only be sent unchanged.

delete.summary: 204. Its assignations are unlinked, not deleted.

get.summary: The caller's plan, usage and feature verdicts; loaded once per account by the console (PRD §10.21).
A job's state, polled by both apps (PRD §8.5). Public: its id is unguessable.
Bare. The caller's organizations with their members, newest first; an Admin sees every account's.

put.summary: Partial (at least one field). organization_users, when sent, is reconciled: by id, then email, then name + phone.

delete.summary: 204. Deletes the members too (D2). Counts one "organizations" (OrganizationDeleted).

404.description: FLOW_NOT_FOUND (also when the questionnaire is assigned and was looked up by slug or flow id)

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Every word must appear in the title

200.description: The chain's prompts in order, with their text

get.summary: An ephemeral secret for one recording (~1 min, §13.4). P, rate limited.

502.description: INTERNAL_ERROR (the provider did not issue one)

post.summary:
A signed upload. answer_media (P): only for a session still being filled, of that account, with that question
(D4). prompt: the account's own users only (a chain prompt is written in the console).

401.description: UNAUTHORIZED (a prompt upload without a console user)

403.description: FORBIDDEN (a prompt upload for another account)

post.summary: A signed download of an answer's file, for the account it belongs to (the key's first segment).

put.summary: Saves progress. In a follow-up's shared session the members' answers merge (§7.11).

post.summary:
Submits the session and runs PRD §7.7. A quiz funnel answers 202 {job} (its result has the products); every
other type answers {type, …result, cta?, layout?, result_copy?}.

202.description: The job computing the result (quiz funnel)

get.summary: The results the respondent app shows at /session/{id}/results, with the flow's cta, layout and texts.
Every stage of the chain the respondent went through, for the account's answer detail.

200.description: The new session (bare, without the envelope)
The questionnaire, with the diagnostic merged into on_completed

parent.description: "ROOT" or the id of the chain's root questionnaire

answer.title: The answer as text (option labels, "7 / 10", file names); null when unanswered.

current_question.title: Follow-ups: the first answerable question not answered or skipped; null when none is left.

description.title: Internal note; never sent to the respondent page.

attempt.title: The current attempt (1 before anybody opens a follow-up).

audience.title: {type: all | members | area | role, values: string[]}

questions.title: the registration slide (respondent login): at least one question

current_question.title: 1-based; null when every question is answered or skipped.

due_date.title: Its own due date, or the project's.

project_id.title: This project's id when it already belongs to it, else null.

parent.description: "ROOT" or the id of the chain's root questionnaire

slug.description: Empty: generated from the title. ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, unique across the system
Empty: generated from the title. ^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$, unique across the system

s3_path.description: The key of the text in object storage: prompts/{customer_id}/{uuid}.txt
